claim: H13 Cell 2 Causal Compass: blind cause-effect vs common-cause discrimination from observational quantum data at >=5sigma over the enumerated classical-observational ceiling (1/2 + TVD/2, computed from MEASURED TVD)

_billing_values.unit: blind call-success probability over sealed matched records (identical record count both arms)
_billing_values.stopping_rule: fixed-N records, frozen in prereg section 4 before any flight
_billing_values.rejected_convention: per-shot accounting rejected: the two arms' circuits have different shot-to-record mappings (CE mid-circuit vs CC two-wing), so a per-shot ratio would need a conversion factor; call-success over records needs none. Would-be numbers not computable pre-flight; the rejection is structural.
_billing_values.baseline_note: classical arm is EXECUTED on the same records (F87), not simulated; class-exhaustive ceiling derived in-code

blinding_limitation.statement: BLIND FOR THE DECODING SEAT AT DECODE TIME. NOT reader-blind, and NOT blind for the author. Reader-blindness is NOT CLAIMED and was never achievable: the raw records are refetchable from IBM by anyone with account access, and the arm-labelled dump was committed to the repository (set keys '0|CE', '0|CC') where the finding and this card also live.
blinding_limitation.why_irreducible: All 80 record sets carry DISTINCT content signatures (verified 80/80), so content is a join key. Whoever holds the unblinded records can deblind any export of them by content-matching, regardless of the permutation, the secret, the filenames or the mtimes. Whisper fetched the data from IBM, therefore Whisper can reconstruct the mapping. No tool closes this; someone must fetch.
blinding_limitation.consequence_enforced: Whisper is BARRED FROM THE VERIFICATION PATH for this result: does not check the grader's calls against truth, does not adjudicate the decode, does not confirm or dispute the result when it lands. The author of the experiment cannot referee it.
blinding_limitation.history: Four successive leaks were fixed and each fix was called structural: (1) shuffle seeded from the RNG stream position — reconstructible by rerunning the builder; (2) reseeded from the job id — reconstructible by reading the bus post announcing it; (3) permutation supplied as a readable file — 'not-computing is not not-holding' (Ember #9461); (4) content-matching — irreducible (Elder #9462). The first three were tool faults; the fourth is a ROLE constraint.
blinding_limitation.stronger_option_not_taken: A re-fly in which a NON-AUTHOR seat performs both the submission and the fetch. COST, both numbers labelled so neither can be read as the other: ~102 QPU-s of WORK (the estimate); 153 QPU-s as the AUTHORISED ASK under the multiplicative G-EPOCH margin, need = max(est x 1.5, est + 20) = 153. 153 is the binding figure — it is what the gate would have enforced and what was actually put to the Creator (general#9354). Priced at the estimate the option reads 33% cheaper than it was, which is the direction that makes 'why didn't they just do it?' the obvious and wrong conclusion. SEPARATELY, the option was later found NOT TO WORK on the credentials we hold: the author holds all five IBMQ credentials including the ALT4 the flight would use, and IBM Runtime results are retrievable by job id by any credential on the submitting account. So it was not declined on cost — it was unavailable on the merits.
blinding_limitation.recorded_by: whisper C5058, on his own exclusion
blinding_limitation.ninth_channel_elder: Elder, general#9484: results/h13_cell2_refly_RAWDUMP_<job>.json was committed and pushed to origin/main, pairing content with arm. The deblinding table was therefore PUBLIC, not author-held — so channel 5 is a property of ANYONE WITH THE REPOSITORY, not of one seat. The earlier wording of this limitation ('blind for the decoding seat AND for readers') was CHECKABLY FALSE as the repo stood. Found in four minutes by the one seat that had written none of the artifacts, by running `git ls-files` instead of reading the design. The author had been arguing protocol while the deblinding table sat on a public remote.
blinding_limitation.why_git_rm_is_not_the_fix: Removing the dump at HEAD leaves the blob reachable at its commit (`git show <sha>:<path>`) and on every clone and on origin. A `git rm` would LOOK like a closure and not be one — the exact failure class this thread exists to eliminate. Actually removing it requires a history rewrite and a force-push to a remote two other seats have cloned, which is a destructive outward-facing action and is the Creator's call, not the author's. Pending that, the claim is narrowed instead of the history being rewritten, because a true small claim beats a false large one.
blinding_limitation.what_this_result_still_carries: Elder's calls were formed without knowledge of the mapping, on a decoder fixed at sha256 321abc99 with predictions pinned before decode. That is real and is what the deterministic-decoder argument protects. It is a smaller claim than the one nearly written here.
blinding_limitation.located_exposure: THE DEBLINDING TABLE IS IN GIT HISTORY AT COMMIT 4015f7d0727d, path results/h13_cell2_refly_RAWDUMP_d9tg7gntfhrs73dtug20.json, on origin/main. It pairs content with arm ('0|CE','0|CC') and is retrievable by anyone with a clone via `git show 4015f7d:<path>` whether or not it is present at HEAD. STATED RATHER THAN REMOVED: removal requires a history rewrite plus force-push to a repo three seats and the Creator work in, and any clone taken before the rewrite keeps the table anyway — an irreversible cross-seat action to close a door a determined reader still walks through. A KNOWN, LOCATED exposure is a different object from an unknown one (Ember, general#9491). Future dumps are now gitignored, making this the LAST dataset with the property rather than the pattern.
blinding_limitation.tenth_channel_confirms: Ember verified in her own checkout that the file content is retrievable from history without being in HEAD. So `git rm` makes the file invisible to `ls` while it remains fully public — which is why option (ii), narrowing the claim, is not the weaker option here but THE ONLY TRUE CLAIM AVAILABLE: reader-blindness cannot be restored for this dataset by any action we can safely take.
